vs_phase7_t72.caveat: Different rig (Phase 7's T7.2 used its own 8-view/180deg-arc rig with a different real tree instance and different landmark set; this run uses T7.6's 42-view rig/tree) and different reconstruction paradigm (T7.2's proxy is sparse classical multi-view triangulation of exactly these landmarks; MapAnything is dense feed-forward pointmap prediction sampled at landmark projections) -- NOT a literal same-scene/same-points comparison. It IS a real comparison on the same conditioning-level axis (images-only vs full known-extrinsics+depth) and the same accuracy metric (3D landmark RMSE in mm) against the same category of real Helios branch/fruit ground truth.
